import os
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter.scrolledtext import ScrolledText
import google.generativeai as genai
import requests

# --- core routing logic ---
def call_gemini(system_prompt, user_input):
    try:
        model = genai.GenerativeModel("gemini-1.5-flash", system_instruction=system_prompt)
        return model.generate_content(user_input).text
    except Exception as e: return f"error: {str(e)}"

def call_groq(system_prompt, user_input):
    try:
        key = os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY", "")
        if not key: return "error: groq key missing."
        r = requests.post("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions", 
                          json={"model": "llama3-70b-8192", "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_input}]}, 
                          headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"})
        return r.json()['choices'][0]['message']['content']
    except Exception as e: return f"error: {str(e)}"

def call_sambanova(system_prompt, user_input):
    try:
        key = os.getenv("SAMBANOVA_API_KEY", "")
        if not key: return "error: sambanova key missing."
        r = requests.post("https://api.sambanova.ai/v1/chat/completions", 
                          json={"model": "Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct", "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_input}]},

from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv, set_key
from rich.console import Console
from rich.prompt import Prompt
from rich.theme import Theme

ares_theme = Theme({"info": "dim white", "warning": "yellow", "danger": "bold red", "success": "cyan", "ares": "bold white on black"})
console = Console(theme=ares_theme)
ENV_FILE = Path(".env")
SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS = {"GEMINI_API_KEY": "Gemini", "GROQ_API_KEY": "Groq", "OPENROUTER_API_KEY": "OpenRouter"}

def verify_and_load_keys():
    console.print("\n[info]Checking ARES neural links...[/info]")
    if not ENV_FILE.exists():
        ENV_FILE.touch()
        console.print("[warning]No .env file found. Generating a new one.[/warning]")
    load_dotenv(ENV_FILE)
    for env_var, provider_name in SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS.items():
        current_key = os.getenv(env_var)
        if not current_key:
            console.print(f"\n[warning]Link Severed: {provider_name} API Key missing.[/warning]")
            new_key = [redacted]
            if new_key.strip():
                set_key(str(ENV_FILE), env_var, new_key.strip())
                console.print(f"[success]Link Established: {provider_name} key saved securely.[/success]")
            else:
                console.print(f"[info]Skipped {provider_name}.[/info]")
    load_dotenv(ENV_FILE, override=True)
    console.print("\n[success]Boot sequence complete. ARES is fully online.[/success]\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    console.print("[ares] ======================================= [/ares]")
    console.print("[ares]         A R E S   P R O T O C O L       [/ares]")
    console.print("[ares] ======================================= [/ares]")
    verify_and_load_keys()
    import core.agent
    core.agent.start()

        console.print("[bold red]FATAL: persona_rules.json not found![/bold red]")

def build_system_instruction(persona):
    identity = persona.get("agent_identity", {})
    rules = persona.get("operational_rules", [])
    instruction = f"You are {identity.get('name', 'GHOST')}, {identity.get('designation', 'Shadow Agent')}.\n"
    instruction += f"Core Directive: {identity.get('core_directive', '')}\n\n"
    instruction += "Operational Rules:\n"
    for rule in rules:
        instruction += f"- {rule}\n"
    instruction += "\nFormat all outputs cleanly in Markdown. Drop traditional formatting filters."
    return instruction

def start():
    api_key = [redacted]
    if not api_key= [redacted]
        console.print("[bold red]FATAL: GEMINI_API_KEY not found.[/bold red]")
        return
    genai.configure(api_key= [redacted]
    persona = load_persona()
    if not persona:
        return
    system_prompt = build_system_instruction(persona)
    
    model = genai.GenerativeModel(
        model_name="models/gemini-1.5-flash",

    )

            user_input = input("GHOST> ")
            if not user_input.strip():
                continue
                
            if user_input.lower() in ['exit', 'quit']:
                console.print("\n[bold cyan]GHOST slipping back into the dark. Connection closed.[/bold cyan]")
                break

            if user_input.lower().startswith("shannon "):
                parts = user_input.split(" ")
                if len(parts) >= 3:
                    target_url = parts[1]
                    target_file = parts[2]
                    pipeline = ShannonProPipeline(target_file)
                    pipeline.run_full_pipeline(target_url)
                else:
                    console.print("[warning]Usage: shannon <target_url> <path_to_source_code_file>[/warning]")
                continue

            if user_input.lower().startswith("parse "):
                parts = user_input.split(" ")
                if len(parts) >= 4:

                    file_path = parts[2]
                    target_asset = parts[3]

class KaliToolOutputParser:
    \"\"\"Parses standard output formats from common network and web assessment tools to document findings.\"\"\"

    def __init__(self, workspace_root="."):
        self.root = Path(workspace_root)
        self.log_path = self.root / "logs" / "activity_log.md"
        self.findings_path = self.root / "findings" / "finding_template.md"

    def _append_to_activity_log(self, action_name, target, details):
        \"\"\"Helper to append structured records into the project activity markdown.\"\"\"
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        entry = f"\n- Time: [{timestamp}]\n"
        entry += f"- Action: Ingested log from {action_name}\n"
        entry += f"- Target: [{target}]\n"
        entry += f"- Result: Log Parsed Successfully\n"
        entry += f"- Notes: {details}\n"
        
        with open(self.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(entry)

    def ingest_nikto_txt(self, file_path, target_asset):
        \"\"\"Parses plain text outputs from web server scanners to find out-of-date components.\"\"\"
        txt_file = Path(file_path)
        if not txt_file.exists():
            console.print(f"[bold red]Error: Log file {file_path} does not exist.[/bold red]")
            return

        items_found = 0
        try:
            with open(txt_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read()
                
            # Basic pattern matching to look for standard finding items labeled in typical text logs
            matches = re.findall(r"\+ OSVDB-\d+:.*|\+ Target .*|\+ Items:.*", content)
            for match in matches:
                items_found += 1
                
            self._append_to_activity_log("Nikto Web Scanner", target_asset, f"Parsed {items_found} informational headers/items.")
            console.print(f"[cyan]Successfully imported Nikto output details for target asset: {target_asset}[/cyan]")
        except Exception as e:
            console.print(f"[bold red]Failed parsing web log: {e}[/bold red]")

    def ingest_generic_terminal_log(self, tool_name, file_path, target_asset):
        \"\"\"Generic parser to ingest standard raw stdout terminal output from miscellaneous utilities.\"\"\"
        log_file = Path(file_path)
        if not log_file.exists():
            console.print(f"[bold red]Error: Reference log file {file_path} not found.[/bold red]")
            return

        try:
            size = log_file.stat().st_size
            self._append_to_activity_log(tool_name, target_asset, f"Ingested plain text log file (Size: {size} bytes).")
            console.print(f"[cyan]Logged raw output from {tool_name} under asset {target_asset} targets.[/cyan]")

class UnifiedToolManager:
    def __init__(self, workspace_root="."):
        self.root = Path(workspace_root)
        self.log_path = self.root / "logs" / "activity_log.md"
        self.findings_path = self.root / "findings" / "finding_template.md"

    def _append_activity(self, tool_name, target, outcome):
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        log_entry = f"\n- Time: [{timestamp}]\n"
        log_entry += f"- Action: Ingested output from {tool_name}\n"
        log_entry += f"- Target: [{target}]\n"
        log_entry += f"- Result: {outcome}\n"
        log_entry += f"- Status: Documented in workspace tracking\n"
        
        with open(self.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(log_entry)

    def parse_log_file(self, tool_type, file_path, target_asset):
        target_file = Path(file_path)
        if not target_file.exists():
            console.print(f"[bold red]Error: Scan log file {file_path} not found.[/bold red]")
            return

        tool_type = tool_type.lower()
        try:
            if tool_type == "nuclei":
                count = 0
                with open(target_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        if line.strip():
                            count += 1
                self._append_activity("Nuclei Scanner", target_asset, f"Processed {count} JSON log records.")
                console.print(f"[cyan]Successfully imported {count} Nuclei findings to workspace logs.[/cyan]")

            elif tool_type == "nikto":
                with open(target_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                matches = re.findall(r"\+ OSVDB-\d+:.*|\+ Target .*|\+ Items:.*", content)
                self._append_activity("Nikto Web Scanner", target_asset, f"Parsed text summary with {len(matches)} contextual reference markers.")
                console.print(f"[cyan]Successfully parsed Nikto logs for asset target: {target_asset}[/cyan]")

            else:
                size = target_file.stat().st_size
                self._append_activity(tool_type.upper(), target_asset, f"Ingested raw text log summary ({size} bytes).")
                console.print(f"[cyan]Logged unstructured output for {tool_type.upper()} under target: {target_asset}[/cyan]")

        except Exception as e:
            console.print(f"[bold red]Log processing failure: {e}[/bold red]")

def require_admin(action, tool_name, detail=""):
    print("Global Admin Gate")
    print("=" * 32)
    print("Admin:", ADMIN_NAME)
    print("Tool:", tool_name)
    print("Action:", action)
    if detail:
        print("Detail:", detail)

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import datetime

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOCS = SRC.parent
DST = DOCS / "Elie"
STAMP = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
BACKUP = DOCS / ("Elie_backup_before_restructure_" + STAMP)

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {"api/secure", "__pycache__"}
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"local_unlock.py"}  # never overwrite local password helper from a package

print("Elie Restructure V2 deploy")
print("Source:", SRC)
print("Target:", DST)

if not DST.exists():
    print("Target Elie folder does not exist. Creating it.")
    DST.mkdir(parents=True)
else:
    print("Backing up current Elie folder...")
    shutil.copytree(DST, BACKUP, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    print("Backup saved:", BACKUP)


def rel_is_excluded(rel: Path) -> bool:
    s = str(rel).replace("\\", "/")
    if s in EXCLUDE_DIRS:
        return True
    if rel.name in EXCLUDE_NAMES:
        return True
    if "__pycache__" in rel.parts:
        return True
    return False

copied = 0
for item in SRC.rglob("*"):
    rel = item.relative_to(SRC)
    if rel_is_excluded(rel):
        continue
    target = DST / rel
    if item.is_dir():
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        continue
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(item, target)
    copied += 1

# Preserve encrypted API keys already in current Elie/api/secure.
(DST / "api" / "secure").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print("Copied files:", copied)
print("Preserved api/secure keys in target.")
print("Done. Run:")
print("cd ~/Documents/Elie")
print("PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -u start_elie.py")

import os, shutil, datetime, subprocess

PROTECTED = [
    "api/key_vault.py",

]

BACKUP_DIR = "fixer_backups"
REPORT_DIR = "reports"
os.makedirs(BACKUP_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(REPORT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def is_protected(path):
    p = path.replace("\\\\", "/")
    for item in PROTECTED:
        if item.endswith("/") and p.startswith(item):
            return True
        if p == item:
            return True
    return False

def backup_file(path):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    safe = path.replace("/", "__")
    dest = os.path.join(BACKUP_DIR, safe + "." + stamp + ".bak")
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)
    return dest

def py_compile(path):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "py_compile", path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    except Exception:
        r = subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "py_compile", path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    ok = r.returncode == 0
def safe_replace(path, old, new):
    if is_protected(path):
        return False, "BLOCKED: protected file. Fix must be reviewed by Senin + ChatGPT."
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return False, "File not found: " + path
    before = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
    if old not in before:
        return False, "Old text not found. No change made."
    backup = backup_file(path)
    after = before.replace(old, new, 1)
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(after)
    if path.endswith(".py"):
        ok, out = py_compile(path)
        if not ok:
            shutil.copy2(backup, path)
            return False, "Fix failed compile. Restored backup. Error: " + out[-1000:]
    return True, "Fix applied safely. Backup: " + backup

def propose_major_fix(title, details):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    path = os.path.join(REPORT_DIR, "elie_major_fix_proposal_" + stamp + ".txt")

    text += "Title: " + str(title) + "\\n\\n"
    text += str(details) + "\\n\\n"
    text += "RULE: This is report-only. Major code changes require Senin + ChatGPT review.\\n"
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
    return path

def fixer_status():
    return """ELIE FIXER MODE ACTIVE
Permission: safe fixer only.
Can inspect project: yes.
Can auto-fix non-protected files: yes, with backup + compile test.
Can touch vault/admin/identity/API keys automatically: no.

def save_report(history):

def call_all_ready_apis(system, prompt, purpose):
    outputs = []
    for name in API_CIRCLE:
        cooling, left, reason = is_cooling(name)
        if cooling:

            print("[SKIP]", msg)
            outputs.append((name, False, msg))
            continue
        print("[DEPLOY]", name, "working on", purpose)
        ok, res = call_provider(name, system, prompt)
        if looks_rate_limited(res):

import os, datetime

PROJECT_ROOT = "."
MAX_FILES = 120

IMPORTANT_NAMES = [
    "admin_gate.py",
    "admin_config.py",
    "elise_core.py",
    "elise_prompts.py",
    "elise_evolution_core.py",
    "elise_learning_core.py",
    "api_circle.py",
    "api_cooldown.py",
    "main.py",
    "elie.py",
    "shannon_core.py",
    "shannon.py"
]

RISK_KEYWORDS = [
    "api_key",
    "password",
    "secret",
    "token",
    "delete",
    "remove",
    "subprocess",
    "eval",
    "exec",
    "urllib.request",
    "urlopen",
    "Authorization",
    "Bearer",
    "APPROVE",
    "vault",
    "cooldown"
]

def collect_files(root=PROJECT_ROOT):
    found = []
    skip_dirs = {".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip_dirs]
        for name in files:
            if name.endswith((".py", ".txt", ".json", ".md")):
                path = os.path.join(base, name)
                found.append(path.replace("./", ""))
    return sorted(found)[:MAX_FILES]

def scan_file(path):
    result = {"path": path, "lines": 0, "risks": [], "imports": []}
    try:
        text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    except Exception as e:
        result["risks"].append("could not read: " + str(e))
        return result
    lines = text.splitlines()
    result["lines"] = len(lines)
    for line in lines[:500]:
        s = line.strip()
        if s.startswith("import ") or s.startswith("from "):
            result["imports"].append(s[:120])
    low = text.lower()
    for word in RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if word.lower() in low:
            result["risks"].append(word)
    return result

def eliy_security_vision():
    files = collect_files()
    scanned = [scan_file(p) for p in files]
    important = [x for x in scanned if os.path.basename(x["path"]) in IMPORTANT_NAMES]
    risky = [x for x in scanned if x["risks"]]
    out = []
    out.append("ELIY SECURITY VISION")
    out.append("=" * 44)
    out.append("Generated: " + datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"))
    out.append("Role: Elise local code/project vision layer")
    out.append("Original Shannon is kept untouched as reference.")
    out.append("")
    out.append("PROJECT FILE COUNT: " + str(len(files)))
    out.append("")
    out.append("IMPORTANT FILES SEEN:")
    for x in important[:30]:
        out.append("- " + x["path"] + " | lines: " + str(x["lines"]))
    out.append("")
    out.append("RISK / CONTROL KEYWORDS SEEN:")
    for x in risky[:40]:
        out.append("- " + x["path"] + " -> " + ", ".join(x["risks"][:10]))
    return chr(10).join(out)

def shannon_security_vision():
    return eliy_security_vision()

import os

os.makedirs(REPORT_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)

def get_reports():
    reports = [f for f in os.listdir(REPORT_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    reports.sort(reverse=True)
    return reports

def open_report(name):
    path = os.path.join(REPORT_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("Report not found: " + name)
        return
    print("")
    print("=== REPORT: " + name + " ===")
    print("-" * 40)
    text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    print(text[:6000])
    if len(text) > 6000:
        print("")
        print("[Report is long. Showing first safe part only.]")
    print("")

def reports_menu():
    while True:
        reports = get_reports()
        print("")
        print("=== Elie Reports Viewer ===")
        print("-" * 32)
        if not reports:
            print("No reports found.")
            input("Press return to go back...")
            return
        print("0. Back")
        print("L. Open latest report")
        for i, r in enumerate(reports[:20], 1):
            print(str(i) + ". " + r)
        print("")
        choice = input("Choose report: ").strip().lower()
        if choice in ["0", "back", "b", "q", "quit"]:
            return
        if choice in ["l", "latest"]:
            open_report(reports[0])
            input("Press return to continue...")
            continue
        if choice.isdigit():
            idx = int(choice) - 1
            if 0 <= idx < len(reports[:20]):
                open_report(reports[idx])
                input("Press return to continue...")
            else:
                print("Invalid report number.")
                input("Press return to continue...")
        else:
            print("Unknown choice.")

ELIE_MODULE = "shannon_core"
ELIE_CHECKPOINT = "004T_version_labeled"

import os
CODE_FOLDER = "code"

def read_code(name):
    path = os.path.join(CODE_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, "File not found: " + name
    try:
        text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
        return text, None
    except Exception as e:
        return None, "Could not read file: " + str(e)

def find_lines(text, keys):
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        low = line.lower()
        for key in keys:
            if key in low:
                hits.append((i, line.strip()[:120]))
                break
    return hits

def section(title, hits):
    out = []
    out.append(title)
    out.append("-" * len(title))
    if not hits:
        out.append("None found.")
    else:
        for line_no, code in hits:
            out.append("Line " + str(line_no) + ": " + code)
    out.append("")
    return out

def analyze_file(name):
    text, err = read_code(name)
    if err:
        return None, err

    inputs = find_lines(text, ["input(", "request.", "request[", "params", "query", "body", "form", "argv"])
    database = find_lines(text, ["sqlite3", "connect(", "cursor", "execute(", "select ", "insert ", "update ", "delete "])
    auth = find_lines(text, ["password", "login", "auth", "token", "session", "cookie", "jwt"])
    routes = find_lines(text, ["@app.route", "router.", "route(", "get(", "post(", "put(", "delete("])
    risky = find_lines(text, ["select", "+", "eval(", "exec(", "os.system", "subprocess", "innerhtml", "document.write"])

    score = 0
    if inputs and database: score += 3
    if auth and database: score += 2
    if routes and inputs: score += 1
    if risky: score += 2

    return {
        "file": name,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "database": database,
        "auth": auth,
        "routes": routes,
        "risky": risky,
        "score": score
    }, None

def build_file_report(name):
    data, err = analyze_file(name)
    if err:
        return err

    out = []
    out.append("Elie Shannon Core Map")
    out.append("File: " + data["file"])
    out.append("Risk score: " + str(data["score"]))
    out.append("=" * 32)
    out.append("")
    out += section("Inputs", data["inputs"])
    out += section("Routes / Endpoints", data["routes"])
    out += section("Database / Queries", data["database"])
    out += section("Auth / Session / Password", data["auth"])
    out += section("Risky Path Clues", data["risky"])
    out.append("Shannon-style paths")
    out.append("-------------------")
    found = False
    if data["inputs"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: user input -> database query.")
    if data["auth"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: auth/session/password logic -> database.")
    if data["routes"] and data["inputs"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: route/endpoint -> user-controlled input.")
    if data["risky"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Risk clues found. Run normal Elie quick/deep/report.")
    if not found:
        out.append("- No obvious Shannon-style path found.")
    out.append("")
    out.append("Next safe actions:")
    out.append("- quick " + name)
    out.append("- deep " + name)
    out.append("- report " + name)
    return "\n".join(out)

import os, base64, hashlib
SECURE_DIR = "api/secure"
CACHE = {}
MAGIC = "ELIEKEY:"

def vault_path(name):
    os.makedirs(SECURE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(SECURE_DIR, name + ".key.enc")

def stream(password, n):
    out = b""
    i = 0
    while len(out) < n:
        out += hashlib.sha256((password + ":" + str(i)).encode()).digest()
        i += 1
    return out[:n]

def xor_bytes(raw, password):
    pad = stream(password, len(raw))
    return bytes([raw[i] ^ pad[i] for i in range(len(raw))])

    os.chmod(vault_path(name), 0o600)
    print("Saved encrypted key:", vault_path(name))

import json, urllib.request
from api.api_settings import API_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
from api.key_vault import load_key

PROVIDER_NAME = "openrouter"
DEFAULT_MODEL = "openrouter/auto"
API_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

def get_key():
    key = load_key("openrouter")
    if key:
        return key
    return None

def call_openrouter(system_prompt, user_prompt, model=DEFAULT_MODEL):
    key = get_key()
    if not key:
        return False, "OpenRouter key missing or vault locked."
    data = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
    }
    body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(API_URL, data=body, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + key)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("HTTP-Referer", "http://localhost")
    req.add_header("X-Title", "Elise Private Assistant")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=API_TIMEOUT) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        text = obj["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        return True, text
    except Exception as e:
        return False, "OpenRouter failed: " + str(e)

from admin_config import ADMIN_NAME, CONTROLLED_ACTIONS, CONSEQUENCE_WARNINGS

    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("[" + stamp + "] " + msg + chr(10))

    print("Admin:", ADMIN_NAME)
    print("Tool:", tool_name)
    print("Action:", action)
    if detail:
        print("Detail:", detail)
    print("")
    print("Consequences / warnings:")
    for w in CONSEQUENCE_WARNINGS:
        print("- " + w)
    print("")
    reason = input("Authorized scope / reason / ticket: ").strip()
    if not reason:
        print("Denied: reason required.")
        log_event("DENIED missing reason | tool=" + tool_name + " | action=" + action)
        return False
    confirm = input("Type APPROVE to continue: ").strip()
    if confirm == "APPROVE":
        print("Approved.")
        log_event("APPROVED | tool=" + tool_name + " | action=" + action + " | reason=" + reason)
        return True
    print("Denied: approval text did not match.")
    log_event("DENIED bad confirmation | tool=" + tool_name + " | action=" + action + " | reason=" + reason)
    return False

import sys
from api.api_router import call_api_router
from api.api_mode import get_api_mode
from api.api_settings import API_BED_VERSION, SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS, API_RULES
from admin_gate import require_admin

VALID = ["local", "groq", "gemini", "groq_then_gemini", "gemini_then_groq", "compare_groq_gemini"]

def show_status():
    print("Elise API Roof")
    print("=" * 32)
    print("Bed version:", API_BED_VERSION)
    print("Current mode:", get_api_mode())
    print("")
    print("Supported providers:")
    for p in SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS:
        print("- " + p)

def show_rules():
    print("API Rules")
    print("=" * 32)
    for r in API_RULES:
        print("- " + r)

def set_mode(mode):
    mode = mode.strip().lower()
    if not require_admin("change_api_mode", "api_control", "Change API mode to: " + mode):
        print("API mode change cancelled.")
        return
    if mode not in VALID:
        print("Invalid mode:", mode)
        print("Valid:", ", ".join(VALID))
        return
    text = "API_MODE = " + repr(mode) + chr(10)
    text += chr(10) + "def get_api_mode():" + chr(10)
    text += "    return API_MODE" + chr(10)
    open("api/api_mode.py", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
    print("API mode set to:", mode)

def test_router():
    mode = get_api_mode()
    system = "You are Elise API roof. Security-only test."
    user = "Test security review: API auth, server config, Shannon findings."
    ok, res = call_api_router(mode, system, user)
    print("Router ok:", ok)
    print("-" * 32)
    print(res)

def help_menu():
    print("Use:")
    print("python api_control.py status")
    print("python api_control.py rules")
    print("python api_control.py set local")
    print("python api_control.py set groq")
    print("python api_control.py set gemini")
    print("python api_control.py set groq_then_gemini")
    print("python api_control.py set gemini_then_groq")
    print("python api_control.py set compare_groq_gemini")
    print("python api_control.py test")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        help_menu()
    elif sys.argv[1] == "status":
        show_status()
    elif sys.argv[1] == "rules":
        show_rules()
    elif sys.argv[1] == "set" and len(sys.argv) >= 3:
        set_mode(sys.argv[2])
    elif sys.argv[1] == "test":
        test_router()
    else:
        help_menu()

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import datetime

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOCS = SRC.parent
DST = DOCS / "Elie"
STAMP = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
BACKUP = DOCS / ("Elie_backup_before_restructure_" + STAMP)

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {"api/secure", "__pycache__"}
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"local_unlock.py"}  # never overwrite local password helper from a package

print("Elie Restructure V2 deploy")
print("Source:", SRC)
print("Target:", DST)

if not DST.exists():
    print("Target Elie folder does not exist. Creating it.")
    DST.mkdir(parents=True)
else:
    print("Backing up current Elie folder...")
    shutil.copytree(DST, BACKUP, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    print("Backup saved:", BACKUP)


def rel_is_excluded(rel: Path) -> bool:
    s = str(rel).replace("\\", "/")
    if s in EXCLUDE_DIRS:
        return True
    if rel.name in EXCLUDE_NAMES:
        return True
    if "__pycache__" in rel.parts:
        return True
    return False

copied = 0
for item in SRC.rglob("*"):
    rel = item.relative_to(SRC)
    if rel_is_excluded(rel):
        continue
    target = DST / rel
    if item.is_dir():
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        continue
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(item, target)
    copied += 1

# Preserve encrypted API keys already in current Elie/api/secure.
(DST / "api" / "secure").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print("Copied files:", copied)
print("Preserved api/secure keys in target.")
print("Done. Run:")
print("cd ~/Documents/Elie")
print("PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -u start_elie.py")

    os.system("clear")

def menu():
    print("")
    print("=== ELIE LAUNCHER ===")
    print("iPhone local security workspace")
    print("-" * 32)
    print("1. Run Elie")
    print("2. Run Shannon file map")
    print("3. Run ProjectMap")
    print("4. Open reports list")
    print("5. Self Improve AI")\n    print("6. Exit")
    print("")

def list_code_files():
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(CODE_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    if not files:
        print("No files found in code/ folder.")
        return []
    print("")
    print("Files in code/:")
    for i, f in enumerate(files, 1):
        print(str(i) + ". " + f)
    print("")
    return files

def run_elie():
    subprocess.run(["python", "main.py"])

def run_shannon():
    files = list_code_files()
    if not files:
        return
    name = input("File name or number: ").strip()
    if name.isdigit():
        idx = int(name) - 1
        if 0 <= idx < len(files):
            name = files[idx]
    subprocess.run(["python", "shannon.py", name])

def run_projectmap():
    subprocess.run(["python", "projectmap.py"])

def old_reports_menu():
    reports = [f for f in os.listdir(REPORT_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    reports.sort(reverse=True)
    print("")
    if not reports:
        print("No reports found.")
    else:
        print("Reports:")
        for i, r in enumerate(reports[:20], 1):
            print(str(i) + ". " + r)
    print("")
    input("Press return to continue...")

def main():
    while True:
        clear_screen()
        menu()
        choice = input("Choose: ").strip()
        if choice in ["1", "elie", "run"]:
            run_elie()
        elif choice in ["2", "shannon", "map"]:
            run_shannon()
            input("Press return to continue...")
        elif choice in ["3", "projectmap", "project"]:
            run_projectmap()
            input("Press return to continue...")
        elif choice in ["4", "reports", "report"]:
            reports_menu()
        elif choice in ["5", "exit", "quit", "q"]:
            print("Goodbye.")
            break
        else:
            print("Unknown choice.")
            input("Press return to continue...")

if __name__ == "__main__":

import os, datetime

PROJECT_ROOT = "."
MAX_FILES = 120

IMPORTANT_NAMES = [
    "admin_gate.py",
    "admin_config.py",
    "elise_core.py",
    "elise_prompts.py",
    "elise_evolution_core.py",
    "elise_learning_core.py",
    "api_circle.py",
    "api_cooldown.py",
    "main.py",
    "elie.py",
    "shannon_core.py",
    "shannon.py"
]

RISK_KEYWORDS = [
    "api_key",
    "password",
    "secret",
    "token",
    "delete",
    "remove",
    "subprocess",
    "eval",
    "exec",
    "urllib.request",
    "urlopen",
    "Authorization",
    "Bearer",
    "APPROVE",
    "vault",
    "cooldown"
]

def collect_files(root=PROJECT_ROOT):
    found = []
    skip_dirs = {".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip_dirs]
        for name in files:
            if name.endswith((".py", ".txt", ".json", ".md")):
                path = os.path.join(base, name)
                found.append(path.replace("./", ""))
    return sorted(found)[:MAX_FILES]

def scan_file(path):
    result = {"path": path, "lines": 0, "risks": [], "imports": []}
    try:
        text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    except Exception as e:
        result["risks"].append("could not read: " + str(e))
        return result
    lines = text.splitlines()
    result["lines"] = len(lines)
    for line in lines[:500]:
        s = line.strip()
        if s.startswith("import ") or s.startswith("from "):
            result["imports"].append(s[:120])
    low = text.lower()
    for word in RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if word.lower() in low:
            result["risks"].append(word)
    return result

def eliy_security_vision():
    files = collect_files()
    scanned = [scan_file(p) for p in files]
    important = [x for x in scanned if os.path.basename(x["path"]) in IMPORTANT_NAMES]
    risky = [x for x in scanned if x["risks"]]
    out = []
    out.append("ELIY SECURITY VISION")
    out.append("=" * 44)
    out.append("Generated: " + datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"))
    out.append("Role: Elise local code/project vision layer")
    out.append("Original Shannon is kept untouched as reference.")
    out.append("")
    out.append("PROJECT FILE COUNT: " + str(len(files)))
    out.append("")
    out.append("IMPORTANT FILES SEEN:")
    for x in important[:30]:
        out.append("- " + x["path"] + " | lines: " + str(x["lines"]))
    out.append("")
    out.append("RISK / CONTROL KEYWORDS SEEN:")
    for x in risky[:40]:
        out.append("- " + x["path"] + " -> " + ", ".join(x["risks"][:10]))
    return chr(10).join(out)

def shannon_security_vision():
    return eliy_security_vision()

    path = os.path.join(PATCH_FOLDER, stamp + "_" + safe_title + ".txt")

from pathlib import Path
targets = ["api_circle.py"]
patterns = ["[API CIRCLE]", "cooldown set", "rate limit detected", "unlocked."]
for name in targets:
    p = Path(name)
    lines = p.read_text(errors="ignore").splitlines()
    out = []
    changed = 0
    for line in lines:
        if "print(" in line and any(x in line for x in patterns):
            indent = line[:len(line)-len(line.lstrip())]
            out.append(indent + "pass  # quieted API log")
            changed += 1
        else:
            out.append(line)
    p.write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print("quieted", changed, "lines in", name)

import os

REPORT_FOLDER = "reports"
os.makedirs(REPORT_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)

def get_reports():
    reports = [f for f in os.listdir(REPORT_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    reports.sort(reverse=True)
    return reports

def open_report(name):
    path = os.path.join(REPORT_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("Report not found: " + name)
        return
    print("")
    print("=== REPORT: " + name + " ===")
    print("-" * 40)
    text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    print(text[:6000])
    if len(text) > 6000:
        print("")
        print("[Report is long. Showing first safe part only.]")
    print("")

def reports_menu():
    while True:
        reports = get_reports()
        print("")
        print("=== Elie Reports Viewer ===")
        print("-" * 32)
        if not reports:
            print("No reports found.")
            input("Press return to go back...")
            return
        print("0. Back")
        print("L. Open latest report")
        for i, r in enumerate(reports[:20], 1):
            print(str(i) + ". " + r)
        print("")
        choice = input("Choose report: ").strip().lower()
        if choice in ["0", "back", "b", "q", "quit"]:
            return
        if choice in ["l", "latest"]:
            open_report(reports[0])
            input("Press return to continue...")
            continue
        if choice.isdigit():
            idx = int(choice) - 1
            if 0 <= idx < len(reports[:20]):
                open_report(reports[idx])
                input("Press return to continue...")
            else:
                print("Invalid report number.")
                input("Press return to continue...")
        else:
            print("Unknown choice.")
            input("Press return to continue...")

ELIE_MODULE = "shannon_core"
ELIE_CHECKPOINT = "004T_version_labeled"

import os
CODE_FOLDER = "code"

def read_code(name):
    path = os.path.join(CODE_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, "File not found: " + name
    try:
        text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
        return text, None
    except Exception as e:
        return None, "Could not read file: " + str(e)

def find_lines(text, keys):
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        low = line.lower()
        for key in keys:
            if key in low:
                hits.append((i, line.strip()[:120]))
                break
    return hits

def section(title, hits):
    out = []
    out.append(title)
    out.append("-" * len(title))
    if not hits:
        out.append("None found.")
    else:
        for line_no, code in hits:
            out.append("Line " + str(line_no) + ": " + code)
    out.append("")
    return out

def analyze_file(name):
    text, err = read_code(name)
    if err:
        return None, err

    inputs = find_lines(text, ["input(", "request.", "request[", "params", "query", "body", "form", "argv"])
    database = find_lines(text, ["sqlite3", "connect(", "cursor", "execute(", "select ", "insert ", "update ", "delete "])
    auth = find_lines(text, ["password", "login", "auth", "token", "session", "cookie", "jwt"])
    routes = find_lines(text, ["@app.route", "router.", "route(", "get(", "post(", "put(", "delete("])
    risky = find_lines(text, ["select", "+", "eval(", "exec(", "os.system", "subprocess", "innerhtml", "document.write"])

    score = 0
    if inputs and database: score += 3
    if auth and database: score += 2
    if routes and inputs: score += 1
    if risky: score += 2

    return {
        "file": name,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "database": database,
        "auth": auth,
        "routes": routes,
        "risky": risky,
        "score": score
    }, None

def build_file_report(name):
    data, err = analyze_file(name)
    if err:
        return err

    out = []
    out.append("Elie Shannon Core Map")
    out.append("File: " + data["file"])
    out.append("Risk score: " + str(data["score"]))
    out.append("=" * 32)
    out.append("")
    out += section("Inputs", data["inputs"])
    out += section("Routes / Endpoints", data["routes"])
    out += section("Database / Queries", data["database"])
    out += section("Auth / Session / Password", data["auth"])
    out += section("Risky Path Clues", data["risky"])
    out.append("Shannon-style paths")
    out.append("-------------------")
    found = False
    if data["inputs"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: user input -> database query.")
    if data["auth"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: auth/session/password logic -> database.")
    if data["routes"] and data["inputs"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: route/endpoint -> user-controlled input.")
    if data["risky"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Risk clues found. Run normal Elie quick/deep/report.")
    if not found:
        out.append("- No obvious Shannon-style path found.")
    out.append("")
    out.append("Next safe actions:")
    out.append("- quick " + name)
    out.append("- deep " + name)
    out.append("- report " + name)
    return "\n".join(out)

    except Exception as e:

def find_lines(text, keys):
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):

        for key in keys:

    return hits

import json, urllib.request

def test_key(n):
    key = input("Paste OpenAI key " + str(n) + ": ").strip()
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.openai.com/v1/models", method="GET")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + key)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        count = len(obj.get("data", []))
        print("KEY", n, "WORKS. Models visible:", count)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("KEY", n, "FAILED:", str(e)[:220])
        return False

def main():
    good = 0
    for i in range(1, 5):
        if test_key(i):
            good += 1
        print("-" * 40)
    print("Working keys:", good, "/ 4")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json, urllib.request
from api.api_settings import API_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
from api.key_vault import load_key

PROVIDER_NAME = "openrouter"
DEFAULT_MODEL = "openrouter/auto"
API_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

def get_key():
    key = load_key("openrouter")
    if key:
        return key
    return None

def call_openrouter(system_prompt, user_prompt, model=DEFAULT_MODEL):
    key = get_key()
    if not key:
        return False, "OpenRouter key missing or vault locked."
    data = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
    }
    body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(API_URL, data=body, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + key)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("HTTP-Referer", "http://localhost")
    req.add_header("X-Title", "Elise Private Assistant")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=API_TIMEOUT) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        text = obj["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        return True, text
    except Exception as e:
        return False, "OpenRouter failed: " + str(e)

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import datetime

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOCS = SRC.parent
DST = DOCS / "Ray"
STAMP = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
BACKUP = DOCS / ("Ray_backup_before_restructure_" + STAMP)

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {"api/secure", "__pycache__"}
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"local_unlock.py"}  # never overwrite local password helper from a package

print("Ray Restructure V2 deploy")
print("Source:", SRC)
print("Target:", DST)

if not DST.exists():
    print("Target Ray folder does not exist. Creating it.")
    DST.mkdir(parents=True)
else:
    print("Backing up current Ray folder...")
    shutil.copytree(DST, BACKUP, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    print("Backup saved:", BACKUP)


def rel_is_excluded(rel: Path) -> bool:
    s = str(rel).replace("\\", "/")
    if s in EXCLUDE_DIRS:
        return True
    if rel.name in EXCLUDE_NAMES:
        return True
    if "__pycache__" in rel.parts:
        return True
    return False

copied = 0
for item in SRC.rglob("*"):
    rel = item.relative_to(SRC)
    if rel_is_excluded(rel):
        continue
    target = DST / rel
    if item.is_dir():
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        continue
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(item, target)
    copied += 1

# Preserve encrypted API keys already in current Ray/api/secure.
(DST / "api" / "secure").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print("Copied files:", copied)
print("Preserved api/secure keys in target.")

﻿import sqlite3
import datetime
import json
import os
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List

class ImportanceScorer:
    @staticmethod
    def score_message(content: str, author_id: int, is_architect: bool, is_mentioned: bool) -> tuple[float, str]:
        importance = 0.3
        msg_type = "transient"
        high_priority_keywords = ['urgent', 'error', 'fail', 'exploit', 'breach', 'deploy', 'system']
        if any(keyword in content.lower() for keyword in high_priority_keywords):
            importance += 0.3
            msg_type = "episodic"
        if is_mentioned:
            importance += 0.2
            msg_type = "episodic"
        if is_architect:
            importance = 1.0
            msg_type = "core"
        importance = min(1.0, importance)
        return importance, msg_type

class KnowledgeGraph:
    def add_entity(self, entity_id: str, entity_type: str, attributes: dict):
        pass

class EnhancedMemoryManager:
    def __init__(self, db_path="enhanced_memory.sqlite"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._init_db()
        self.knowledge_graph = KnowledgeGraph()
        
    def _init_db(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memories 
                          (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, timestamp TEXT, user_id INTEGER, user_name TEXT, 
                           content TEXT, importance REAL, memory_type TEXT, decay_rate INTEGER, 
                           access_count INTEGER, last_accessed TEXT, channel_id INTEGER)''')
        cursor.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS core_memories 
                          (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT, added_by INTEGER, timestamp TEXT, category TEXT)''')
        cursor.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_profiles 
                          (user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_name TEXT, preferences TEXT, facts TEXT, 
                           interaction_count INTEGER, first_seen TEXT, last_seen TEXT, is_architect INTEGER)''')
        cursor.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS policies 
                          (policy_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, policy_value TEXT)''')
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

    def add_message(self, user_id: int, user_name: str, content: str, channel_id: int, is_architect: bool, is_mentioned: bool):
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        memory_id = f"msg_{timestamp}_{user_id}"
        importance, mem_type = ImportanceScorer.score_message(content, user_id, is_architect, is_mentioned)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('''INSERT INTO memories 
                          (id, timestamp, user_id, user_name, content, importance, memory_type, decay_rate, access_count, channel_id) 
                          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                       (memory_id, timestamp, user_id, user_name, content, importance, mem_type, 7, 0, channel_id))
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

    def list_memories(self, filters: dict = None, limit: int = 20) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        query = "SELECT * FROM memories WHERE 1=1"
        params = []
        if filters:
            if 'min_importance' in filters:
                query += " AND importance >= ?"
                params.append(filters['min_importance'])
            if 'memory_type' in filters and filters['memory_type'] != 'all':
                query += " AND memory_type = ?"
                params.append(filters['memory_type'])
        query += " ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?"
        params.append(limit)
        cursor.execute(query, params)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

# Ray 2.0 LUCYINSPSCELOTON

A clean, runnable Python core skeleton renamed from the Lucy project prompt into **Ray 2.0 LUCYINSPSCELOTON**.

## Identity boundary
Ray is not Lucy. This project only uses Lucy-inspired architecture patterns: Guardian Core, permission keys, modular memory, logs, backups, response checker, and engine routing.

## Run
From inside the extracted folder:

```bash
python3 start_Ray.py
```

Or:

```bash
cd src
python3 Ray.py
```

## Test commands
- `status`
- `version`
- `identity`
- `safety`
- `memory`
- `search guardian`
- `remember safe test note`
- `exit`

## Notes
- No desktop UI/orb/Tkinter/PyQt5 is included.
- The engine route is a placeholder, so it runs without API keys.
- Later API keys should be stored in environment variables, never inside code or memory files.

cd ~/Documents/Ray_Restructured_V2

cd ~/Documents/Ray

async def compile_and_send_file(filename: str, content: str, **kwargs) -> str:
    """
    Compiles a given string of content into a text file and sends it to the current Discord channel.
    This is useful for providing long code blocks, summaries, or any text the user wants to download.
    
    Args:
        filename: The name of the file to create (e.g., "response.txt", "code.py").
        content: The text content to be placed inside the file.
    
    Returns:
        A confirmation message indicating success or failure.
    """
    print(f"📁 [Tool] Compiling content into file: '{filename}'")
    
    message = kwargs.get("message")
    
    if not message:
        error_msg = "❌ [Internal Error] The 'message' object was not provided to the compile_and_send_file tool."
        print(error_msg)
        return error_msg

    try:
        file_content = io.StringIO(content)
        discord_file = discord.File(fp=file_content, filename=filename)
        await message.reply(f"Here is the file you requested:", file=discord_file)
        
        return f"Note to model: You have successfully sent the file named '{filename}'. Now, formulate a brief, natural response to the user to let them know the task is complete."

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Critical Error in compile_and_send_file: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc() 
        return f"❌ Failed to create or send the file. An internal error occurred: {e}"

import json, urllib.request
from api.api_settings import API_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
from api.key_vault import load_key

PROVIDER_NAME = "openrouter"
DEFAULT_MODEL = "openrouter/auto"
API_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

def get_key():
    key = load_key("openrouter")
    if key:
        return key
    return None

def call_openrouter(system_prompt, user_prompt, model=DEFAULT_MODEL):
    key = get_key()
    if not key:
        return False, "OpenRouter key missing or vault locked."
    data = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
    }
    body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(API_URL, data=body, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + key)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("HTTP-Referer", "http://localhost")
    req.add_header("X-Title", "Elise Private Assistant")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=API_TIMEOUT) as r:
            raw = r.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        text = obj["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        return True, text
    except Exception as e:
        return False, "OpenRouter failed: " + str(e)

records.excerpt:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REPORTS = ROOT / "ray" / "reports"
PROPOSALS = ROOT / "ray" / "proposals"

SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "dist", "build"}
INTERESTING_EXTS = {".py", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx", ".html", ".css", ".json", ".md", ".txt", ".toml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".env"}

class CodeMapper:
    def clean_path(self, raw):
        p = Path(raw).expanduser()
        return p if p.exists() else None

    def iter_files(self, raw):
        path = self.clean_path(raw)
        if path is None:
            return []
        if path.is_file():
            return [path]
        files = []
        for p in path.rglob("*"):
            if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in p.parts):
                continue
            if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in INTERESTING_EXTS:
                files.append(p)
        return files[:500]

    def map_path(self, raw_path):
        path = self.clean_path(raw_path)
        if path is None:
            return f"Path not found: {raw_path}"
        files = self.iter_files(raw_path)
        lines = ["RAY CODE MAP", f"Target: {path}", f"Files scanned: {len(files)}", ""]
        for f in files:
            try:
                size = f.stat().st_size
            except Exception:
                size = 0
            lines.append(f"- {f} ({size} bytes)")
        text = "\n".join(lines)
        REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out = REPORTS / ("code_map_" + datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") + ".txt")
        out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        return text + f"\n\nSaved report: {out}"

    def security_report(self, raw_path):
        path = self.clean_path(raw_path)
        if path is None:
            return f"Path not found: {raw_path}"
        files = self.iter_files(raw_path)
        risky = ["password", "secret", "api_key", "token", "eval(", "exec(", "subprocess", "os.system", "pickle", "shell=True", ".env"]
        findings = []
        for f in files:
            try:
                text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            except Exception:
                continue
            for word in risky:
                if word.lower() in text.lower():
                    findings.append(f"{f}: contains '{word}'")
        lines = ["RAY SAFE SECURITY REPORT", f"Target: {path}", f"Files scanned: {len(files)}", "", "Findings:"]
        lines += ["- " + x for x in findings[:200]] if findings else ["- No simple keyword risks found."]
        lines += ["", "This is a first-pass safe review, not a full audit."]
        text = "\n".join(lines)
        REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out = REPORTS / ("security_report_" + datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") + ".txt")
        out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        return text + f"\n\nSaved report: {out}"

    def propose_safe_review(self, raw_path):
        path = self.clean_path(raw_path)
        if path is None:
            return f"Path not found: {raw_path}"
        PROPOSALS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out = PROPOSALS / ("review_plan_" + datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") + ".txt")
        text = f"""RAY REVIEW PROPOSAL

Target:
{path}

Proposed safe actions:
1. Map files.
2. Identify entry points.
3. Identify config/API key risks.
4. Identify unsafe subprocess/os.system/eval/exec usage.
5. Identify auth/session/data handling issues.
6. Create fix proposals only.
7. Wait for APPROVE APPLY before changing any files.

No files changed by this proposal.
"""
        out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        return text + f"\nSaved proposal: {out}"

import os, datetime
from admin_config import ADMIN_NAME, CONTROLLED_ACTIONS, CONSEQUENCE_WARNINGS

LOG_FILE = "logs/global_admin_gate.log"
os.makedirs("logs", exist_ok=True)

def log_event(msg):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("[" + stamp + "] " + msg + chr(10))

def require_admin(action, tool_name, detail=""):
    print("Global Admin Gate")
    print("=" * 32)
    print("Admin:", ADMIN_NAME)
    print("Tool:", tool_name)
    print("Action:", action)
    if detail:
        print("Detail:", detail)
    print("")
    print("Consequences / warnings:")
    for w in CONSEQUENCE_WARNINGS:
        print("- " + w)
    print("")
    reason = input("Authorized scope / reason / ticket: ").strip()

import os

def ask_key(provider):
    provider = provider.lower().strip()
    if provider == "groq":
        env_name = "GROQ_API_KEY"
        label = "Groq API key"
    elif provider == "grok_xai":
        env_name = "XAI_API_KEY"
        label = "Grok/xAI API key"
    else:
        return ""

    existing = os.environ.get(env_name, "").strip()
    if existing:
        use_existing = input(label + " already exists for this session. Use it? y/n: ").strip().lower()
        if use_existing in ["y", "yes"]:
            return existing

    print("")
    print("Enter " + label)
    print("It will NOT be saved to file.")
    key = input(label + ": ").strip()
    return key

import os, time, datetime
from admin_gate import require_admin
from api.key_vault import unlock_many
from api_circle import API_CIRCLE, call_provider, circle_call, api_circle_status
from api_cooldown import set_cooldown, is_cooling, looks_rate_limited
from elise_core import elise_system_prompt
from elise_learning_core import learning_doctrine, learning_extraction_prompt
from eliy_bridge import eliy_security_vision

REPORT_DIR = "reports"
MEMORY_DIR = "memory"
CANDIDATE_CONVO = os.path.join(MEMORY_DIR, "candidate_conversation_improvements.txt")
RUN_SECONDS = 1800
PACE_SECONDS = 20
COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 300
os.makedirs(REPORT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(MEMORY_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

def show(title, text="", limit=1000):
    print("")
    print("=" * 50)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 50)
    if text:
        text = str(text)
        print(text[:limit])
        if len(text) > limit:
            print("... trimmed")

def append_file(path, text):
    with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text + chr(10))

def save_report(history):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    path = os.path.join(REPORT_DIR, "elie_convo_max_deploy_" + stamp + ".txt")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(history)
    print("[REPORT SAVED]", path)
    return path

def convo_prompt(cycle, history):
    eliy = eliy_security_vision()
    prompt = "MISSION: Improve Elie conversation mode only." + chr(10)
    prompt += "Cycle: " + str(cycle) + chr(10)
    prompt += "Do not suggest live code rewriting. Do not weaken safety. Do not merge Lucy and Elise." + chr(10)
    prompt += "Focus on how Elie should talk better, understand Senin better, explain better, and feel less command-only." + chr(10)
    prompt += chr(10) + "PROJECT VISION FROM ELIY:" + chr(10) + eliy[:3000]
    prompt += chr(10) + chr(10) + "RECENT DEPLOY HISTORY:" + chr(10) + history[-2500:]
    prompt += chr(10) + chr(10) + "Return this format:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "CONVERSATION PROBLEM:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "BETTER REPLY STYLE:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "MEMORY NEEDED:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "SAFETY LINE:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "NEXT CONVERSATION UPGRADE:" + chr(10)
    prompt += "DO NOT DO:" + chr(10)
    return prompt

def call_all_ready(system, prompt, purpose):
    outputs = []
    for name in API_CIRCLE:
        cooling, left, reason = is_cooling(name)
        if cooling:
            msg = name + " skipped cooling " + str(left) + "s " + reason
            print("[SKIP]", msg)
            outputs.append((name, False, msg))
            continue
        print("[CONVO DEPLOY]", name, "working")
        ok, res = call_provider(name, system, prompt)
        if looks_rate_limited(res):
            set_cooldown(name, COOLDOWN_SECONDS, "rate limit detected")
        outputs.append((name, ok, str(res)))
        print("[DONE]", name, ok)
    return outputs

def combine_outputs(outputs):
    parts = []
    for name, ok, text in outputs:
        parts.append("PROVIDER: " + name)
        parts.append("OK: " + str(ok))

from self_improve_ai import run as self_improve_ai_run
import os
import subprocess
from reports_viewer import reports_menu

CODE_FOLDER = "code"
REPORT_FOLDER = "reports"

os.makedirs(CODE_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(REPORT_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)

def clear_screen():
    os.system("clear")

def menu():
    print("")
    print("=== ELIE LAUNCHER ===")
    print("iPhone local security workspace")
    print("-" * 32)
    print("1. Run Elie")
    print("2. Run Shannon file map")
    print("3. Run ProjectMap")
    print("4. Open reports list")
    print("5. Self Improve AI")\n    print("6. Exit")
    print("")

def list_code_files():
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(CODE_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    if not files:
        print("No files found in code/ folder.")
        return []
    print("")
    print("Files in code/:")
    for i, f in enumerate(files, 1):
        print(str(i) + ". " + f)
    print("")
    return files

def run_elie():
    subprocess.run(["python", "main.py"])

def run_shannon():
    files = list_code_files()
    if not files:
        return
    name = input("File name or number: ").strip()
    if name.isdigit():
        idx = int(name) - 1
        if 0 <= idx < len(files):
            name = files[idx]
    subprocess.run(["python", "shannon.py", name])

def run_projectmap():
    subprocess.run(["python", "projectmap.py"])

def old_reports_menu():
    reports = [f for f in os.listdir(REPORT_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    reports.sort(reverse=True)
    print("")
    if not reports:
        print("No reports found.")
    else:
        print("Reports:")
        for i, r in enumerate(reports[:20], 1):
            print(str(i) + ". " + r)
    print("")
    input("Press return to continue...")

def main():
    while True:
        clear_screen()
        menu()
        choice = input("Choose: ").strip()
        if choice in ["1", "elie", "run"]:
            run_elie()
        elif choice in ["2", "shannon", "map"]:
            run_shannon()
            input("Press return to continue...")
        elif choice in ["3", "projectmap", "project"]:
            run_projectmap()
            input("Press return to continue...")
        elif choice in ["4", "reports", "report"]:
            reports_menu()
        elif choice in ["5", "exit", "quit", "q"]:
            print("Goodbye.")
            break
        else:
            print("Unknown choice.")
            input("Press return to continue...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class ElieDesktopApp:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Elie Desktop")
        self.root.geometry("760x620")
        self.root.minsize(620, 480)

        self.elie = None
        self.response_queue = queue.Queue()

        self.build_ui()
        self.boot_elie()
        self.check_queue()

    def build_ui(self):
        self.title_label = tk.Label(
            self.root,
            text="Elie",
            font=("Segoe UI", 22, "bold")
        )
        self.title_label.pack(pady=(14, 2))

        self.status_label = tk.Label(
            self.root,
            text="Starting...",
            font=("Segoe UI", 10)
        )
        self.status_label.pack(pady=(0, 10))

        self.chat = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(
            self.root,
            wrap=tk.WORD,
            font=("Segoe UI", 11),
            height=24
        )
        self.chat.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=14, pady=(0, 10))
        self.chat.config(state=tk.DISABLED)

        bottom = tk.Frame(self.root)
        bottom.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=14, pady=(0, 14))

        self.entry = tk.Entry(
            bottom,
            font=("Segoe UI", 12)
        )
        self.entry.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True, ipady=8)
        self.entry.bind("<Return>", self.send_message)

        self.send_button = tk.Button(
            bottom,
            text="Send",
            font=("Segoe UI", 11, "bold"),
            command=self.send_message
        )
        self.send_button.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=(10, 0), ipadx=16, ipady=6)

        if ElieCore is None:
            self.status_label.config(text="Elie import failed")
            self.add_message("System", f"Could not import ElieCore:\n{IMPORT_ERROR}")
            return

        try:
            self.elie = ElieCore()
            self.status_label.config(text="Elie is online")
            self.add_message("Elie", "I’m here. Desktop interface is running.")
        except Exception as e:
            self.status_label.config(text="Elie boot failed")
            self.add_message("System", f"Elie boot error:\n{e}")

    def add_message(self, sender, message):
        self.chat.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.chat.insert(tk.END, f"{sender}: {message}\n\n")
        self.chat.see(tk.END)
        self.chat.config(state=tk.DISABLED)

    def send_message(self, event=None):
        text = self.entry.get().strip()
        if not text:
            return

        self.entry.delete(0, tk.END)
        self.add_message("Senin", text)

        if self.elie is None:
            self.add_message("System", "Elie is not loaded.")
            return

        self.status_label.config(text="Elie is thinking...")
        self.send_button.config(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.entry.config(state=tk.DISABLED)

        thread = threading.Thread(target=self.get_elie_reply, args=(text,), daemon=True)
        thread.start()

    def get_elie_reply(self, text):
        try:
            if hasattr(self.elie, "process"):
                reply = self.elie.process(text)
            elif hasattr(self.elie, "respond"):
                reply = self.elie.respond(text)
            elif hasattr(self.elie, "chat"):
                reply = self.elie.chat(text)
            else:
                reply = "ElieCore loaded, but I could not find process/respond/chat method."
        except Exception as e:
            reply = f"Elie error:\n{e}"

        self.response_queue.put(reply)

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

def is_protected(path):
    p = str(path).replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./")
    protected_list = globals().get("PROTECTED", PROTECTED_FALLBACK)
    for x in protected_list:
        if x.endswith("/") and p.startswith(x):
            return True
        if p == x:
            return True
    return False

def read_file(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return ""
    return open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()

def backup_file(path):
    os.makedirs("neural_backups", exist_ok=True)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return ""
    safe = path.replace("/", "__")
    dest = os.path.join("neural_backups", safe + "." + now() + ".bak")
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)
    return dest

def compile_py(path):
    for py in ["python3", "python"]:
        try:
            r = subprocess.run([py, "-m", "py_compile", path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)
            return r.returncode == 0, r.stdout + r.stderr
        except Exception:
            pass
    return False, "No python command worked."

    start = "BEGIN_REWRITE"

    if start in text and end in text:

    return ""

    body += chr(10) + "EXTRACTED CODE:" + chr(10) + str(code)
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(body)
    return path

]

def collect_files(root=PROJECT_ROOT):

    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root):

        for name in files:
            if name.endswith((".py", ".txt", ".json", ".md")):
                path = os.path.join(base, name)

    for word in RISK_KEYWORDS:

import os, base64, hashlib
SECURE_DIR = "api/secure"
CACHE = {}
MAGIC = "ELIEKEY:"

def vault_path(name):
    os.makedirs(SECURE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(SECURE_DIR, name + ".key.enc")

def stream(password, n):
    out = b""
    i = 0
    while len(out) < n:
        out += hashlib.sha256((password + ":" + str(i)).encode()).digest()
        i += 1
    return out[:n]

def xor_bytes(raw, password):
    pad = stream(password, len(raw))
    return bytes([raw[i] ^ pad[i] for i in range(len(raw))])

def save_key(name):
    key = input("Paste [redacted]
    password = [redacted]
    raw = (MAGIC + key).encode("utf-8")
    enc = base64.b64encode(xor_bytes(raw, password)).decode("ascii")
    open(vault_path(name), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(enc)
    os.chmod(vault_path(name), 0o600)
    print("Saved encrypted key:", vault_path(name))

def load_key(name):
    if name in CACHE:
        return CACHE[name]
    path = vault_path(name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):

from approval_gate import request_approval

PATCH_FOLDER = "patches"
os.makedirs(PATCH_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)

def make_patch_plan(title, target_file, reason, plan_lines):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    safe_title = title.replace(" ", "_").replace("/", "_")
    path = os.path.join(PATCH_FOLDER, stamp + "_" + safe_title + ".txt")

    out.append("Title: " + title)
    out.append("Target file: " + target_file)

    out.append("")
    out.append("Planned changes:")

        out.append("- " + line)
    out.append("")
    out.append("Status: plan only, not applied")

import os

REPORT_FOLDER = "reports"
os.makedirs(REPORT_FOLDER, exist_ok=True)

def get_reports():
    reports = [f for f in os.listdir(REPORT_FOLDER) if not f.startswith(".")]
    reports.sort(reverse=True)
    return reports

def open_report(name):
    path = os.path.join(REPORT_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("Report not found: " + name)
        return
    print("")
    print("=== REPORT: " + name + " ===")
    print("-" * 40)
    text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
    print(text[:6000])
    if len(text) > 6000:
        print("")
        print("[Report is long. Showing first safe part only.]")
    print("")

def reports_menu():
    while True:
        reports = get_reports()
        print("")
        print("=== Elie Reports Viewer ===")
        print("-" * 32)
        if not reports:
            print("No reports found.")
            input("Press return to go back...")
            return
        print("0. Back")
        print("L. Open latest report")
        for i, r in enumerate(reports[:20], 1):
            print(str(i) + ". " + r)
        print("")
        choice = input("Choose report: ").strip().lower()
        if choice in ["0", "back", "b", "q", "quit"]:
            return
        if choice in ["l", "latest"]:
            open_report(reports[0])
            input("Press return to continue...")
            continue
        if choice.isdigit():
            idx = int(choice) - 1
            if 0 <= idx < len(reports[:20]):
                open_report(reports[idx])
                input("Press return to continue...")
            else:
                print("Invalid report number.")
                input("Press return to continue...")
        else:
            print("Unknown choice.")
            input("Press return to continue...")

import os
CODE_FOLDER = "code"

def read_code(name):
    path = os.path.join(CODE_FOLDER, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, "File not found: " + name
    try:
        text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
        return text, None
    except Exception as e:
        return None, "Could not read file: " + str(e)

def find_lines(text, keys):
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        low = line.lower()
        for key in keys:
            if key in low:
                hits.append((i, line.strip()[:120]))
                break
    return hits

def section(title, hits):
    out = []
    out.append(title)
    out.append("-" * len(title))
    if not hits:
        out.append("None found.")
    else:
        for line_no, code in hits:
            out.append("Line " + str(line_no) + ": " + code)
    out.append("")
    return out

def analyze_file(name):
    text, err = read_code(name)
    if err:
        return None, err

    inputs = find_lines(text, ["input(", "request.", "request[", "params", "query", "body", "form", "argv"])
    database = find_lines(text, ["sqlite3", "connect(", "cursor", "execute(", "select ", "insert ", "update ", "delete "])
    auth = find_lines(text, ["password", "login", "auth", "token", "session", "cookie", "jwt"])
    routes = find_lines(text, ["@app.route", "router.", "route(", "get(", "post(", "put(", "delete("])
    risky = find_lines(text, ["select", "+", "eval(", "exec(", "os.system", "subprocess", "innerhtml", "document.write"])

    score = 0
    if inputs and database: score += 3
    if auth and database: score += 2
    if routes and inputs: score += 1
    if risky: score += 2

    return {
        "file": name,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "database": database,
        "auth": auth,
        "routes": routes,
        "risky": risky,
        "score": score
    }, None

def build_file_report(name):
    data, err = analyze_file(name)
    if err:
        return err

    out = []
    out.append("Elie Shannon Core Map")
    out.append("File: " + data["file"])
    out.append("Risk score: " + str(data["score"]))
    out.append("=" * 32)
    out.append("")
    out += section("Inputs", data["inputs"])
    out += section("Routes / Endpoints", data["routes"])
    out += section("Database / Queries", data["database"])
    out += section("Auth / Session / Password", data["auth"])
    out += section("Risky Path Clues", data["risky"])
    out.append("Shannon-style paths")
    out.append("-------------------")
    found = False
    if data["inputs"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: user input -> database query.")
    if data["auth"] and data["database"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: auth/session/password logic -> database.")
    if data["routes"] and data["inputs"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Possible path: route/endpoint -> user-controlled input.")
    if data["risky"]:
        found = True
        out.append("- Risk clues found. Run normal Elie quick/deep/report.")
    if not found:
        out.append("- No obvious Shannon-style path found.")
    out.append("")
    out.append("Next safe actions:")
    out.append("- quick " + name)
    out.append("- deep " + name)
    out.append("- report " + name)
    return "\n".join(out)

So, an API is an **Application Programming Interface**. It's a set of rules and protocols that allows different software applications to talk to each other and share information or functionality.

**One level deeper:**

When you make a request through an API, it's like placing an order. The API defines:

1.  **What kind of requests you can make:** These are often called "endpoints." For example, if you're using a weather API, there might be an endpoint for `get_current_weather` or `get_forecast`.
2.  **How to make those requests:** This involves specifying the data you need (like a city name for the weather) and how to format it (e.g., using specific parameters in a URL).
3.  **What kind of responses you'll get back:** The API will return data, usually in a structured format like JSON or XML, so your application can easily understand and use it.

Essentially, APIs act as intermediaries, abstracting away the complexity of how one system works from another. This allows developers to build applications by leveraging existing services without needing to know the intricate details of those services. ﻿from ai_bridge import send_message, read_latest_messages, save_decision, read_rules

print("Ray-Elie bridge ready.")
print("Commands:")
print("1 = Ray ask Elie")
print("2 = Read latest bridge messages")
print("3 = Save decision")
print("4 = Read rules")
print("q = quit")

while True:
    cmd = input("\nBridge> ").strip().lower()

    if cmd == "q":
        break

    if cmd == "1":
        topic = input("Topic: ").strip()
        body = input("Message to Elie: ").strip()
        path = send_message("Ray", "Elie", topic, body)
        print("Sent:", path)

    elif cmd == "2":
        print(read_latest_messages())

    elif cmd == "3":
        title = input("Decision title: ").strip()
        body = input("Decision: ").strip()
        path = save_decision(title, body)
        print("Saved:", path)

    elif cmd == "4":
        print(read_rules())

    else:
        print("Unknown command.")

class RayElieCouncil:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Ray ⇄ Elie Council Room")
        self.root.geometry("1180x760")
        self.root.minsize(950, 620)

        self.core = None
        self.running = False
        self.transcript = ""
        self.topic = ""
        self.minutes = 5
        self.allow_deploy = False

        self.boot_core()
        self.build_ui()
        self.theme()
        self.say("System", "Council Room ready. Set topic, minutes, and whether deployment is allowed.")

    def boot_core(self):
        if RayCore is None:
            self.core = None
            return
        try:
            self.core = RayCore()
        except Exception:
            self.core = None

    def build_ui(self):
        self.root.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.root.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        self.header = tk.Frame(self.root)
        self.header.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=18, pady=(16, 8))
        self.header.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.title = tk.Label(
            self.header,
            text="Ray ⇄ Elie Council",
            font=("Consolas", 24, "bold"),
            anchor="w"
        )
        self.title.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")

        self.status = tk.Label(
            self.header,
            text="SEPARATE AIS / SHARED BRIDGE",
            font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"),
            padx=12,
            pady=6
        )
        self.status.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="e")

        self.body = tk.Frame(self.root)
        self.body.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=18, pady=8)
        self.body.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.body.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.chat = tk.Text(self.body, wrap="word", font=("Consolas", 10), padx=16, pady=14)
        self.chat.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        self.chat.configure(state="disabled")

        self.scroll = tk.Scrollbar(self.body, command=self.chat.yview)
        self.scroll.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
